title: All done deals in July 2026
summary: A roundup of significant football transfers in July 2026 across English and Scottish leagues. The article covers signings and departures in the Premier League, Scottish Premiership, EFL, and Women's Super League during the transfer window.
content: Check out the significant signings and departures in the Premier League, Scottish Premiership, EFL and Women's Super League.

zh.title: 2026年7月完成的所有交易
zh.summary: 关于2026年7月英格兰和苏格兰联赛中重大足球转会的综述。该文章涵盖英超、苏格兰超级联赛、英足总联赛和女超联赛在转会窗口期间的球员引进和离队。

title: Middlesbrough sign USA midfielder Berhalter
summary: Middlesbrough has signed Sebastian Berhalter, a midfielder from Canadian club Vancouver Whitecaps, on a four-year deal. The English club completed the transfer for an undisclosed fee to bolster their midfield options.
content: Middlesbrough sign Vancouver Whitecaps midfielder Sebastian Berhalter for an undisclosed fee on a four-year deal.

zh.title: 米德尔斯堡签下美国中场球员贝哈尔特
zh.summary: 米德尔斯堡从加拿大俱乐部温哥华白帽队签下中场球员塞巴斯蒂安·贝哈尔特，合同期限为四年。英格兰俱乐部以未公开的费用完成转会，以加强其中场阵容。

title: Birmingham & Preston - Barcelona's unlikely UK camp
summary: Barcelona will conduct their pre-season training at St George's Park in England and face Championship opponents Birmingham City and Preston. The arrangement marks an unusual choice for the Spanish club's summer preparation.
content: Barcelona will be training at St George's Park this week and taking on Championship sides Birmingham City and Preston.

zh.title: 伯明翰和普雷斯顿——巴塞罗那不太可能的英国训练营
zh.summary: 巴塞罗那将在英格兰的圣乔治公园进行季前训练，并与英冠对手伯明翰城和普雷斯顿进行比赛。这一安排标志着这家西班牙俱乐部夏季准备的不寻常选择。

title: Cucurella gets tattoo of Spain coach De la Fuente
summary: Spain defender Marc Cucurella honored his promise by getting a tattoo of World Cup-winning coach Luis de la Fuente. The permanent tribute celebrates Spain's success under De la Fuente's management.
content: Spain defender Marc Cucurella keeps his promise to get a tattoo of World Cup-winning coach Luis de la Fuente.

zh.title: 库库雷利纹身纹上西班牙主教练德拉夫恩特
zh.summary: 西班牙后卫马克·库库雷利践行承诺，在身上纹上了世界杯冠军教练路易斯·德拉夫恩特的肖像。这个永久性的致敬彰显了西班牙在德拉夫恩特执教下取得的成功。

title: Grealish misses Man City tour despite training return
summary: Jack Grealish has been excluded from Manchester City's pre-season tour of Asia despite returning to training. The winger continues his recovery from a foot injury and will not feature in the upcoming tour matches.
content: Jack Grealish will not make his return in a Manchester City shirt after being left out of the club's pre-season tour of Asia as he continues to recover from a foot injury.

zh.title: 格雷利什虽恢复训练但缺席曼城亚洲之旅
zh.summary: 杰克·格雷利什尽管已恢复训练，但被曼彻斯特城队排除在亚洲季前赛之外。这名边锋继续恢复脚伤，将不会参加即将进行的巡回赛。

title: Uefa World Cup boycott may be raised over Fifa plan
summary: UEFA's 55 member associations will convene for an emergency meeting to address FIFA's controversial plan to sell stakes in major competitions. A potential World Cup boycott may be considered as a response to the proposal.
content: Uefa's 55 member associations will hold an emergency meeting this week to discuss Fifa's controversial proposals to sell stakes in its major competitions.

zh.title: 欧足联可能因国际足联计划而提出世界杯抵制
zh.summary: 欧足联55个成员协会将召开紧急会议，以应对国际足联有争议的计划，即在重大赛事中出售股份。世界杯抵制可能被视为对该提案的回应。

title: Rangers set to make profit on Antman - gossip
summary: Rangers have accepted a bid from Belgian club Anderlecht for winger Oliver Antman, signaling a profitable sale. Meanwhile, Celtic's permanent offer for Benjamin Arthur was rejected as Scottish clubs remain active in the transfer market.
content: Rangers have accepted a bid from Anderlecht for winger Oliver Antman, while Celtic have had a permanent offer for Benjamin Arthur rejected.

zh.title: 流浪者队有望在安特曼交易中获利 - 传闻
zh.summary: 流浪者队已接受比利时俱乐部安德莱赫特对边锋奥利弗·安特曼的报价，预示着这笔交易将带来利润。与此同时，凯尔特人对本杰明·亚瑟的永久报价被拒，苏格兰俱乐部在转会市场上保持活跃。

title: Diomande's rapid and remarkable rise to Real Madrid
summary: Yan Diomande has rapidly risen from relative obscurity to the verge of becoming Real Madrid's record signing. The winger's remarkable trajectory demonstrates his quick emergence as a target for Europe's elite clubs.
content: Yan Diomande has quickly gone from being a relatively unknown winger to the brink of becoming Real Madrid's record signing.

zh.summary: 延·迪奥曼德从相对籍籍无名迅速崛起，即将成为皇家马德里创纪录的签约。这位边锋的非凡轨迹展示了他如何迅速成为欧洲顶级俱乐部的目标。

content: Will you get today's player in as few attempts as possible?

title: Brighton's Welbeck set for Chelsea medical
summary: Brighton striker Danny Welbeck has received permission to undergo a medical examination at Chelsea as his transfer to Stamford Bridge advances. The move appears imminent as the clubs finalize negotiations.
content: Brighton striker Danny Welbeck is given permission to have a medical at Stamford Bridge as his move to Chelsea moves closer.

zh.title: 布莱顿韦尔贝克准备接受切尔西体检
zh.summary: 布莱顿前锋丹尼·韦尔贝克已获准接受切尔西的医学检查，随着他向斯坦福桥的转会推进。随着两家俱乐部敲定谈判细节，这笔交易似乎即将完成。
